operational_contract.daily_collection: Explicit baseline. Source cadence is independent and recorded separately in registry. No real-time or worldwide completeness claim.
operational_contract.lookback: Use at least 48 hours publication windows with overlap where the API supports it; fetch rolling snapshots otherwise and disclose missing historical retention.
operational_contract.network: Fixed HTTPS origin/path allowlist; redirect:manual then fail/reject3xx; do not follow a redirect or switch egress after access denial. Never fetch links/articles/media.
operational_contract.limits: 30 seconds entire request;256 KiB unless approved structured hazard exception up to1 MiB. Parse all returned metadata before newest100 selection; report all caps and count gaps.
operational_contract.daily_health: Store last_successful_fetch_at, status, HTTP/error, Retry-After, bodybytes, response_count, accepted_count, items_truncated, body_truncated, date_range_available, empirical_oldest_date, retention_gap and timezone_unknown. HTTP200 alone is not health: reject HTML, stale/invalid/error JSON and missing expected arrays.
operational_contract.rate_behavior: No retries after this pass for GDELT429 or WTO402. No Retry-After was supplied by GDELT; quarantine/cooldown and expose blocked state. For Malaysia family stay below4 requests/minute; Only two MY endpoints are enabled.
operational_contract.dedupe: Use provider stable ID; revisions change content hash without resetting first_seen_at. RSS uses guid/id/link; fallback canonicalURL+publication timestamp. Explicitly label derived IDs.
operational_contract.time_semantics: All nullable provider timestamps are independently preserved. Date-only effective/observation/forecast fields belong in facts. Never use fetched_at as publication_at or calculate publication latency when published_at is null.
operational_contract.country_semantics: US/DE/CH/MY publisher country is provenance only. Multilateral publisher country null. Coordinates/countries are source provided only; any future title-derived entity/country must carry inferred basis/evidence, never masquerade as supplied.
operational_contract.safe_content: No content:encoded, abstracts, descriptions, photos, article bodies or full warning instructions retained. Headline/link/time metadata by default; licensed hazard/fuel facts can be structured.
